At Alai Labs, we offer Remote Operation and Remote Monitoring  an Intelligent Platform for the Production/cleaning/public infrastructuremaintenance Industry to maximize productivity and minimize wastage.
The application of AGV/Robotic arm in a Low Volume and High Mix production job has a significant impact on the initial system setup cost, posing a major challenge for the industry in reducing opex costs through automation. This challenge presents a substantial market opportunity, with a few hundred billion dollars at stake globally. Today, Alai Labs' technology stack/platform achieves swift deployment of remote operation and monitoring using the three main technology pillars (1) Metaverse, (2) Autonomous moving robot and (3) integrated IoT sensors . The Platform is successfully implemented in a waste management segment such as drain cleaning and janitorial operation. The technology stack can be quickly deployed to other industries with a few IoT sensor add-ons and by modifying the programming sequence of the system control flow.
We stand at the forefront of the digital revolution, offering cutting-edge AI-based Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) solutions focusing on sustainability. Our expertise encompasses providing solutions for movable asset tracking and digital transformation in various sectors, including container terminals, the security industry, building management, warehouse automation, and waste management. Using state-of-the-art IoT sensors, deep learning edge cameras, and AI/ML cloud servers, we deliver end-to-end solutions that automate data collection through smart sensors.

Distribution and supply of medicines and medical commodities, including advanced and niche products. We supply hospitals, pharmacists, clinics, government tenders and partners, leveraging a strong distribution network in Singapore and the region.
6. Digital Care
Clinic management systems, digital portals and mobile health applications that enable medical benefits administration, care coordination and easier access to services. Built by a physician led team to improve efficiency and deliver data driven insights without adding clinical burden.

WHO WE ARE
Atelier Modus is people-led innovation agency offering customer experience strategies, user-centric solutions for deep tech innovations and design thinking capability building.
The agency was found in August 2020 by Thierry Do, a veteran with 3 decades of experiences in the industry.
WHAT WE BELIEVE IN
We believe in designing user-centric solutions that empower the lives of people.
WHY ATELIER MODUS?
Unconventionally Innovative
Atelier Modus was started with a simple philosophy: Challenging the status quo. We help organisations understand unmet needs, wants and desires of the customers, unlock new markets, find new customers, create new opportunities, generate new value streams and increase shareholder value.
Modus is a Latin word that means way of doing something. Our work evolves challenging the status quo.
User First
Our work focuses on user-centric approach. We adopt an interpretivist view by understanding what the world means to end-users as oppose to the factist view. The factist view assumes there is a right answer leading to accurate predictions. Our work is not about predictive research, but exploratory research that aims to bring the point-of-view of the users in the discussion.
Focused on your bottom line
We'll admit. We lack a few things...Like attitude, ego, and layers of bureaucracy. We have other things on our mind. Like your bottom line. Where every dollar spent must propel your business forward.
Sure, awards matter; but not at the expense of business results. Do not get us wrong. Creativity is the hallmark of our agency, and we have plenty of successful (and hilarious) stories to share with you.

BIG ASS SOLUTIONS
As our name suggests, Big Ass Fans isn't your traditional business. While the quirky name understandably garners a lot of attention, it's the serious work behind the scenes that drives our continued success in industrial, commercial and residential spaces.
Headquartered in Lexington, Kentucky, we design, engineer and manufacture overhead and directional fans that range in size from 18 inches to 24 feet (45.7cm to 7.4m) in diameter. Unlike typical fans, Big Ass Fans couple energy-efficient motors with patented airfoil designs, inspired by airplane wings, to move large volumes of air quietly and efficiently.
At the time of the company's founding in 1999, our first models were designed to bring comfort and safety to farms and factories, which typically lacked air conditioning. Customers started installing our industrial fans in air-conditioned schools, churches and offices, so we invented a silent motor and offered stunning designs to meet the sound and aesthetic needs of these spaces. In 2012, Big Ass Fans launched Haiku the reinvention of the home ceiling fan that boasts an award-winning minimalist design and revolutionary energy-efficient motor. Haiku now features Senseme Technology, an onboard computer and array of sensors that keeps you comfortable automatically.

The company is a private limited company incorporated and domiciled in Singapore. We are well positioned to emerge as a leader in drug-eluting stents, an evolving therapy that is rapidly gaining market share from traditional cardiovascular therapies.
The company's holding company is Biosensors International Group, Ltd incorporated in Bermuda, which is also the ultimate holding company. The holding company is also listed in the stock exchange of Singapore. In June 2006, Biosensors was named one of 50 medical technology companies to be watched in Medical Device and Diagnostic Industry magazine's 50 companies to watch, which cited Biosensors' innovative biodegradable-polymer drug-eluting stents as one of the reasons for the Company to be watched.
Our Mission
Through our high quality medical devices, we impact the lives we touch, and we are committed to continue investing in and developing pioneering medical technology, pharmacological research, and engineering new medical devices that will further benefit our patients. This will create the greatest possible patient outcomes, and provide value to our stakeholders including physicians, shareholders and employees.
Biosensors' Technology
Biosensors' BioMatrix drug-eluting stent is unique in that it uses a proprietary biodegradable polymer and anti-restenotic drug, Biolimus A9�. Our Axxion drug-eluting stent is a polymer-free system in which the drug is directly coated on the stent over a layer of glycocalix, a substrate designed to improve biocompatibility of the metal stent surface after the drug is released. Cardiologists have commented that BioMatrix and Axxion drug-eluting stent which have no polymer remaining in the body after the drug elution is complete offer good alternatives to currently-available drug-eluting stent.

name: CAMECA
description:
CAMECA, a business unit of AMETEK, Inc., is a world-leading designer, manufacturer and service provider of advanced scientific instruments for elemental, isotopic and atomic-scale materials characterization. Founded in France in 1929, CAMECA has established a global reputation for innovation and technical excellence, serving customers in research, academia, government laboratories and high-technology industries worldwide.
CAMECA is the pioneer and recognized market leader in several key microanalytical technologies, including Electron Probe Microanalysis (EPMA), Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS) and Atom Probe Tomography (APT). The company also develops advanced ion source technologies, including Electron Cyclotron Resonance (ECR) sources, delivering solutions that enable precise chemical, isotopic and structural characterization of materials at micro- and nano-scale dimensions.
CAMECA's instrumentation is used across a broad range of applications including semiconductor manufacturing, advanced materials development, nanotechnology, geoscience, environmental sciences, nuclear research, energy technologies and industrial process control. Its solutions support quality assurance, failure analysis, process optimization, research and development, and scientific discovery.
Headquartered in Gennevilliers, France, with technology centers in France and the United States and a worldwide network of sales and service organizations, CAMECA provides comprehensive customer support throughout the entire lifecycle of its instruments. The company operates under internationally recognized quality standards and continually invests in long-term research and development to expand analytical capabilities and address emerging scientific and industrial challenges.

name: CYBER TEST SYSTEMS
description:
Cyber Test Systems provides affordable network traffic generator solutions from 10 Mbps up to 100 Gbps helping manufacturers, service providers, enterprise IT, defense contractors and governments to run functional, performance, security, stability and high-availability tests on network infrastructure, replicating real world legitimate and malicious application traffic.
Cyber Test Systems solutions help to measure current cyber detection and cyber defense capabilities in order to identify opportunities for Cyber Incident Response Plan improvements including team process, network, security and application infrastructures.
Cyber Test Systems uses real threats, pulled from their research across the internet and regenerates them realistically using their solutions replicating legitimate production traffic throughout the exercise networks.
Cyber Test Systems Network Traffic Generator CTS-NTG offers the capabilities to generate single-vector cyber attack scenarios such as :
- Denial of Service (DoS)
- Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS)
- Reflective Denial of Service (RDoS)
- Distributed Reflective Denial of Service (DRDoS)
- Server Side Vulnerabilities and Exploits
- Client Side Vulnerabilities and Exploits
- Web Exploit Kits
- Malicious Domains
- Malicious Websites
- Malicious Phishing Websites
- Newly Emerging and Known Malwares
- Botnet Communications between Command and Control (C&C) and Bots
Cyber Test Systems solutions enable the generation of multi-vector cyber attack scenarios.
Cyber Test Systems solutions can be easily integrated in Cyber Range - Cyber Defense Training Centers to train and evaluate Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC) and Cyber Incident Response (CIRT) teams on their ability to execute their Cyber Incident Response Plans against single-vector and multi-vector cyber attack scenarios. Cyber Range exercises Green ,Yellow, Red, Blue and White Teams for the most realistic attack scenarios.

name: DO NOT DESIGN LLP
description:
At Do Not Design, design goes beyond mere aesthetics. With a results-oriented approach, this part research, part brand consultancy focuses on deep research, exploration, and experimentation to create transformative solutions. They harness insights driven by psychology and human behaviour, allowing them to deliver designs that are not only visually striking but also impactful and effective.
With a unique blend of creativity and strategic thinking, Do Not Design has built a reputation for shaping brand identities that resonate on a deeper level with audiences. The agency's emphasis on understanding the human experience allows them to craft designs that forge lasting connections between brands and their consumers.
Their portfolio includes notable work with Harry Halim, an online identity that went on to grace Paris runway shows, Luxola, once a beauty startup, owes its transformative rebranding to Do Not Design, paving the way for its acquisition by LVMH and evolution into e-Sephora.
Further showcasing their creative brilliance, Do Not Design was instrumental in the creation of the Singapore Pavilion at the Venice Biennale, a project that demonstrated their ability to merge design with culture and global art narratives. Their rebranding of Alchemist, Meatmen, Rachelrax, Officine Paladino, Meatmen and memorable designs for brands like Nike, Revlon, Noah speak to their versatility, expertise, and commitment to creating memorable, lasting impacts. The studio has also involved in the arts and culture with DECK, National Gallery, National Museum of Singapore, etc.
Through research-driven solutions, Do Not Design continues to shape and redefine design, proving that great design is not just about how things look but about how they work and how they make people feel. Their approach has proven time and again that design is a powerful tool for storytelling, growth, and lasting change.

name: DP DESIGN PTE LTD
description:
DP Design Pte Ltd (DPD) has been in operation since 1982 and has undertaken many significant projects in Singapore and overseas.  Prior to its formation, DPD was an in-house interior design arm of DP Architects (DPA). This working relationship enabled DPD to acquire the skill and ability to synthesize architectural and interior design in buildings as an integrated and wholesome solution.
The directors of DPD are all qualified architects and this attribute enabled them to fully understand and comprehend the architectural and spatial relationship and potential of projects undertaken. It is manifested in many projects handled by the firm.
The appointment of the firm in 1997 to undertake the interior design of The Esplanade ?Theatres on the Bay marks the beginning of the firm?s involvement in large civic and commercial projects. This project consists of a 2000 seats concert hall, 1800 seat lyric theatre and related commercial facilities. The successful completion of this project enabled the firm to secure works in other large projects such as the interior design of The HDB HUB, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Building, The Singapore Press Holdings HQ, The Singapore Stock Exchange and the refurbishment of Marina Square Mall. We have also been commissioned to undertake large overseas projects such as The Dubai Mall and the Performing Arts Centre in Suzhou China.
DPD has developed its expertise beyond interior design. It has been commissioned to undertake space planning for large corporate offices and the positioning and branding strategy for retail outlets. These have built upon the continual desire to explore new grounds and to extend the frontier of interior design as the sole objective to a broader and holistic concept of design that embraces all aspects of commercial and individual needs of our clients.
description_short: Integrates architectural and interior design expertise for commercial, institutional and cultural buildings across Singapore and internationally since 1982.

Our extensive knowledge and multidisciplinary approach in facade engineering consistently deliver exceptional solutions that are original, practical and within budget. Our emphasis on being actively involved early in the development process provides our clients with greater opportunities to customise facade designs and solutions to their specific needs. From design to construction and post-completion assessment, our team provides an integrated approach to all aspects of facade engineering.
DPF aims to be at the forefront in terms of the technological systems deployed for the design of building envelopes. We use the most advanced computer modelling software to carry out the parametric engineering of key structural elements of the facade for fast optimisation and value-engineering. BIM is employed to model complex free-form building envelopes, for accurate visualisations and for clash detection with structural and architectural components. DPF also use 3D printing technology for scaled models of key facade elements to assist architects, designers and developers conceptualise the appearance of the building envelope.

Our consultants have had prior Certification Body as well as Industry experience. Ministry Of Manpower Approved Risk Management Consulting/ Auditing
With the enforcement of the Workplace Safety and Health (Risk Management) Regulations the implementation of a sound risk management system has become mandatory for all workplaces in Singapore. Greensafe is a Ministry of Manpower approved risk consultant.  This means that qualifying companies that engage the services of Greensafe may apply to the Risk Management Assistance Fund (RMAF) which offsets the consultancy fee substantially.  In addition, we are also approved by Ministry of Manpower to conduct safety audits.  For more information, please visit the MOM website at www.mom.gov.sg.
National Environment Agency Accredited Safety Audits
Companies with an NEA license for the import, sale, storage, transportation and use of hazardous substances are required to conduct safety audits to systematically identify and address deficiencies in their management systems and practices for managing hazardous substances.  Greensafe provides NEA accredited consultants who lend their professional expertise in assessing hazardous substance management and recommending action plans for improvement and thus assisting in compliance with NEA�s requirements.

name: HYDROINFORMATICS INSTITUTE PTE. LTD.
description:
The Hydroinformatics Institute provides specialist consultancy services in the areas of water resources management and computational oceanography. The company integrates the latest developments in computer modelling of water resources with astute data analysis, allowing companies to sift through complex water data in real time.
Services on offer include:
1.Development and maintenance of Operational Management Systems and Information Management Systems for marine and freshwater environments.
2.Hydrodynamic and water quality modelling for Environmental Impact Assessments and Environmental Monitoring and Management Plans.
3.Weather risk advisory using radar now-casting, high-resolution numerical weather prediction and data assimilation.
The Institute has a Master Agreement with the National University of Singapore (NUS) allowing it to use and commercialize Intellectual Property developed at the University. The Institute acts as a link between academia and the real world, finding application for developments in simulation modelling and information communication technology in hydraulics, hydrology and environmental engineering. The Institute has multiple contracts with government agencies, private and public listed firms, as well as NGOs in Southeast Asia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
The origins of the Hydroinformatics Institute lie in the NUS-based Singapore Delft Water Alliance (SDWA), a Center of Excellence for research, development and consultancy in the area of urban water resource management. With its multi-disciplinary team and active international links, SDWA handled projects relevant to catchment hydrology, coastal hydrodynamics, water resources and climate change, publishing more than 250 scientific articles and presenting more than 200 seminars in national and international conferences over a five-year period.

There are a total of 20 requirements which includes management responsibility, quality systems and process control. Besides being a BICSI Corporate member, LanTroVision currently has 7 accredited RCDD (Registered Communication Distribution Designer) and 2 PMP (Project Management Professional) in its staff strength. The RCDDs are leveraged for project and technical consultation and quality assurance. We are also accredited by BICSI the Platinum Prestige Consultant status and the Platinum Prestige Contractor status.

name: LITA OCEAN PTE. LTD.
description:
SHIP BUILDING, SHIP REPAIR AND MARINE TRANSPORTATION SERVICES
Lita Ocean was founded in Singapore in the late 1970s. The company started operations as a tug and barge operator in the regional trade. Key services we provided were transportation of sludge and explosive cargo. In a few years, we expanded to provide floating crane, tank cleaning, landing craft and emergency oil spill response services.
In the late 1990s, the company took over the current waterfront premises and ventured into shipbuilding and shipyard services. We identified an increasing niche demand in the region for lightweight and fast boats. As the benefits of using aluminium in boat construction gained popularity, we became a specialist in aluminium shipbuilding.
Our breakthrough in shipbuilding came in the year 2000 when we delivered 2 units of high speed patrol interceptors to the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority of Singapore. By the mid-2000s, we had delivered more than 50 vessels ranging from 12 metres to 22 metres. Key projects include a contract to provide 7 units of 12 metre boats to the Immigration and Checkpoints Authorities of Singapore and a order of 4 units of 16 metre crew boat to the US Navy for operations in Diego Garcia, Indian Ocean.
In 2007 and 2008, we delivered 5 units of 22 metre supply vessels and 2 units of 26 metre crew boat to offshore vessel operators. In the last few years, our efforts to expand our market reach have resulted in our first sale of vessels to India, China, Australia, Saudi Arabia and West Africa, establishing a reputation as a renowned builder of quality vessels.
We have a fleet of various types of vessels available for charter including ro-ro vessels, landing crafts, floating cranes, tugs, barges, launches, ferries, pilot boats, mooring boats and multipurpose work boats. With the increase in our fleet size, we attained ISO 9001:2008 certification for our marine services.

description: QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) unites the power of Quidel Corporation and Ortho Clinical Diagnostics behind a shared mission of developing and manufacturing innovative technologies that raise the performance of diagnostic testing and create better patient outcomes across the entire healthcare continuum. Ranked among the worlds largest in vitro diagnostics (IVD) providers, QuidelOrtho is building on more than 120 years of collective experience and innovation. We combine industry-leading expertise in immunoassay and molecular testing with a global footprint in point-of-care settings, clinical labs and transfusion medicine to advance critical diagnostic solutions at scale. We were a pioneer in women health diagnostics, developing the earliest lateral-flow pregnancy test strips. We introduced the first FDA approved rapid antigen diagnostic test for Influenza A and Influenza B and launched the first-ever product to determine Rh+ or Rh- blood type. We also developed the world first tests for the detection of antibodies against HIV and hepatitis C. We engineered a patented dry-slide technology that has been revolutionary in both reducing the cost and extending the reach of IVD testing. And we stood at the forefront of diagnostics innovation throughout the coronavirus pandemic, developing one of the earliest molecular PCR assays for SARS-CoV-2, the first FDA emergency use authorized rapid antigen test that delivers results in 15 minutes, and high-volume antibody and antigen tests for COVID-19. Today, QuidelOrtho comprehensive product portfolio covers a wide range of point-of-care tests for infectious diseases, critical cardiac health and autoimmune biomarkers, and a host of clinical and at-home products to detect COVID-19. Our sophisticated yet simple-to-use point-of-care tests enable clinicians to chart a course of treatment and empower people to take charge of their health.

For the firm, the dialogue of architectural elements shapes a space, takes it beyond its everyday, functional character. It is with this ethos that Park Associates pursues a vision of architecture as a fundamental articulation of space and form, through which beauty and purity can be discovered.
The firm strategy is one of subtraction and control to preserve the necessary simplicity of spaces. Each project is undertaken with a rigorous eye for detail, placement and materials, with an artistic sensitivity to the intangibles of light, space and form. Charting a journey for the user in an unique space; creating sophisticated spaces that inspire, invigorate, and refine the senses,that is what Park Associates sets out to achieve.
In tandem with its explorations of spaces, the firm remains sensitive to environmental concerns, seeking to appropriate eco-friendly materials and strategies into each project.
description_short: Designs functional, minimalist architectural spaces using rigorous material selection and spatial composition to create sophisticated environments that balance aesthetic beauty with practical purpose.

name: PARK SYSTEMS PTE. LTD.
description:
Park Systems Pte. Ltd. is Singapore Headquater of Park Systems Corp.
Products:
Park Systems serves its customers by providing a complete range of AFM solutions including AFM systems, options and software, along with global service and support.
Main Businesses:
Park Systems is the leading nanotechnology solutions partner for the most challenging problems of nanoscale research and industrial applications.
Park Systems provides original and innovative AFM solutions for the most accurate nanoscale measurement. In nanoscale metrology, having data that is repeatable, reproducible, and reliable is just as crucial as resolution. The innovative crosstalk-elimination (XE) metrology platform ushered in a new era of nanometrology that overcomes non-linearity and non-orthogonality associated with conventional piezotube based systems. Park Systems' innovative AFM technology is a disruptive market force and it expands the application of nanometrology beyond the limits of conventional AFM technology.
Park Systems promotes sustainable, long-term growth of its AFM business by constantly seeking to address the changing needs of AFM users. Our comprehensive portfolio of products, software, services, and expertise is designed and engineered to help customers achieve the nanometrology performance that meets the needs and requirements of present and future applications. Since improvements in nanometrology today are key to enabling tomorrow's research, analysis, processing and product manufacturing, our innovative technology and market leadership in the field of nanometrology secure our future at the forefront of the AFM industry.
description_short: Supplies atomic force microscopy (AFM) systems, options and software with global service support for nanoscale research and industrial metrology applications.

name: PSYTECH LIMITED
description:
The founding Directors of Psytech Ltd are Alan Kitching and Colin Valsler. They have both trained as hardware and software engineers and possess a thorough understanding of computers and information technology. The company specialises in the use of this technology, particularly in the implementation of psychometric testing and personnel selection. Psytech Ltd was formed in March prior to this both directors were members of the Royal Air Force. The principle directors both made major contributions to the design and development of the Aircrew Aptitude Testing System. At the time, this system was one of the first, large scale, computer based testing systems in the world. Founded in 1989, Psytech Ltd has a significant amount of experience gained from work on flight/task simulation equipment and in the development of psychometric measurement systems. Since 1989 Psytech Ltd have developed, improved and extended their product base in order to keep abreast of the ever changing computer capabilities and advances in the field of the pilot selection process.
Our product base can now be conveniently divided into two main categories - aptitude testing and the assessment of people's character or personality.
In the main, our work to develop psychometric testing software for character or personality assessment and job roles is bespoke and specific to our individual client's requirements. For this reason our off the shelf product list is concentrated around our unique delivery system and psychometric testing software targeted at the aviation sector. Our bespoke services to psychologists are for personality assessment and human resource support. There are many aptitude test authors but we collaborate with, or are contracted to, the market leaders to supply batteries of tests used globally for pilot selection in the main and for other aviation related positions. Our ambition is always to achieve high quality software that is modern, robust and user-friendly yet cost effective.

name: PYXIS MARITIME PTE. LTD.
description:
Maritime is the backbone of commerce transporting 90% of the worlds trade.
But there is a critical Maritime crisis - vessels are heavily reliant on diesel. If
nothing radical is done to shape up the industry, it is projected to be
responsible for 17% of the worlds total annual CO2 emissions by 2050.
Specifically, the coastal maritime sector is technologically lagging, and its
ultra-fragmented nature results in a lack of collective synergy to push for
transformation. Coastal vessels are at high risk of becoming irrelevant in the
new green economy.
The time is now for us to make a difference.
Introducing Pyxis, a fleet of first-of-its-kind electrified vessels which are
energy-efficient, maintenance-lite, and digitalised. The electric vessels will be
leased or sold to existing vessel owners, providing a significant leap in vessel
performance, changing the way services are provided to the maritime sector.
Pyxis will revolutionise the coastal maritime industry and sail us towards a
carbon-free and sustainable future.
Pyxis is led by maritime veterans and supported by leading Singapore coastal
vessel owners and industry partners. We will target key port services segments
in Singapore and scale up to sister-ports in the region.
With the sustainability and decarbonisation movements disrupting the maritime
industry, Pyxis will allow for ports around the world to operate greener, cleaner,
and more efficiently.
There is no better time than now, and no better place than from Maritime
global hub, Singapore, to begin this maritime transformation.

name: REACH THERAPY SERVICES
description:
We provide psychological services for children with special needs; in particular Autism Spectrum Disorder. We conduct assessments, intervention, school observations, consultations and training. Our Educational Psychologist, Mr Bimal Rai, has over 20 years experience working with children with special needs. Apart from providing intervention, such as TEACCH, PECS, Social Stories, etc., he is an RDI Program Certified Consultant.  RDI is a unique program which addresses the core deficits of Autism and other disorders from a developmental perspective. Where a child lacks certain developmental milestones, RDI plugs these gaps gradually and systematically. Using the principles of RDI we aim to empower parents and teachers in managing children with special needs or learning difficulties. By imparting practical knowledge and strategies parents and teachers walk away with a better understanding of the condition afflicting the child and how they can help ease the struggles faced by our youngsters through intervention.
Children we have worked with have demonstrated the following:
Improved Perspective Taking
Developments in Flexible Thinking in relation to the social world
Increased Desire to Interact with others
Dramatic improvement in Meaningful Communication
An Increased Sense of Competency
Schools or agencies who seek training or workshops can tell us of their needs and we will customize a programme to suit their requirements. Training/Workshops we have conducted include:
Managing Controlling Behaviour
Autism: The Core Deficits
Understanding the ADHD Profile and Difficulties in School
Individualized Education Plans
RDI: Bridging the Social Gaps
Shadow Teacher training
Workshops for Social Stories,TEACCH, PECS, etc.
description_short: Provides psychological assessments, interventions (TEACCH, PECS, RDI), and parent-teacher training for children with autism spectrum disorder and special needs.

name: RED APRICOT PTE. LTD.
description:
An organization's needs to get a quick and accurate view of their business in this VUCA (Volatile, Uncertain, Complex and Ambiguous) world.
Radical innovations have arisen in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) technologies with SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BPC and SAP S/4 HANA leading the way. However, even with all the innovations, operationalizing an efficient EPM process is a challenge due to the traditional approach taken for adopting these solutions. These approaches heavily focus on ineffective application configuration instead of a business-relevant, collaborative process design.
On a mission to provide organizations with a risk-free SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for Planning, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA for Group Reporting adoptions, Red Apricot developed JustPerform. It took more than 18 months to build this unified platform using all our combined experience and in-depth knowledge of implementation processes.
Today, using the power of our purpose-built cloud platform JustPerform, Red Apricot leads organizations away from an ineffective application configuration towards collaborative process design and automated deployments.
JustPerform simplifies collaborative business process definition, enables visual process modelling and automates process deployment using advanced Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning algorithms. To put it in simple terms, using the JustPerform platform, project stakeholders can input the desired elements of their EPM strategy, and our AI-based algorithms automatically write the code for fast and successful deployment.
With the purpose-built JustPerform, Red Apricot has been rapidly growing in the SAP EPM space. It has been recognized as one of the top 10 innovative EPM solution providers by APAC CIO Outlook in their Enterprise Performance Management Special Edition. Additionally, Red Apricot is an SAP Gold Partner and has SAP Recognized Expertise status in Enterprise Planning and Analysis.

SITTI SpA designs and produces Air Traffic Control digital communication systems for Civil and Military Customers all over the world, since its foundation in 1946.

SITTI works according to NATO AQAP 110/150 Quality standards and is ISO 9001 certified.
The SITTI M600 Digital VCSS offers full versatility to the Air Traffic Control (ATC) environment through a modular design based on International Telecommunication Union (ITU) standards of A-law encoded voice PCM technology. Safe and ultra reliable communications facilities are achieved by internal system duplication, modular redundancy and the use of proven technology.
Human Machine Interface (HMI) units are fully configurable through the VCSS system Configuration Control and Monitoring (CCM) workstation. VCSS system interface capabilities encompass both analogue and digital connections for Air/Ground Radio, full Intercom, Intra and Inter- Station ATC communication requirements. Interface characteristics address specialised requirements such as MFC-N5 and MFC-R2 format calling and ATS-Qsig protocols developed for use in the Eurocontrol and other ICAO ATS systems. Flexible design philosophy allows for cost effective and efficient VCSS system customisation to meet specialised customer requirements whilst maintaining full communications reliability.

name: SatSense Ltd
description:
SatSense is a UK geospatial analytics company specialising in Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) for ground and asset movement monitoring. Headquartered in Leeds, we deliver readily available and affordable displacement insights that help infrastructure owners, operators, and their consultants improve the resilience and safety of transport, utilities, energy and the built environment.
Our platform turns satellite radar into clear, decision-ready intelligence; tracking millimetre-scale movement over large areas and long time spans. We provide baseline studies, time-series analysis, trend/change detection and alerting, with outputs delivered via dashboards, GIS files and reports to fit existing workflows.
What we do
Nationwide to site-specific monitoring for rail, highways, water, energy, ports and property.
Construction and asset risk management: subsidence, uplift, settlement, tunnelling impacts and third-party works.
Event and anomaly assessment (e.g., strike/impact investigations) and post-event forensics.
Portfolio screening to prioritise inspections and optimise maintenance budgets.
How we do it
Advanced processing of open and commercial SAR data (e.g., Sentinel-1 and historical archives such as ERS/Envisat/ALOS, plus taskable missions where required).
Scalable pipelines that rapidly produce consistent, comparable results at city, corridor or national scale.
Easy integration with client GIS and asset systems; clear communication of uncertainty and confidence.
SatSense combines radar science with practical engineering know-how to reduce risk, target investigations and cut cost. Our mission is to be the leading provider of readily available and affordable InSAR ground movement data and derived products, supporting smarter, safer and more sustainable infrastructure.

name: SHEVS IFT CONSULTANTS PTE. LTD.
description:
SHEVS IFT CONSULTANTS PTE LTD is a licensed corporation registered with the Professional Engineers Board to offer professional engineering consultancy services. SHEVS specialises in fire/smoke control and fire safety engineering designs based on the Singapore Fire Codes and the Singapore Fire Safety Engineering Guidelines 2015.
Very often, the increasing scale or complexity of building architectural designs will inevitably result to challenging circumstances for the implementation of prescriptive code-compliant fire safety measures. Some of the common deviations to prescriptive fire code are :
i. Engineered smoke control system
- Enlarged smoke reservoir size and length
- Inadequate atrium space in width and area
- Enlarged fire compartment
ii. Means of escape
- Extended travel distances
- Excessive egress capacity of occupants
- Internal discharge of exit staircases
iii. Set back distances from notional boundary
- Insufficient set back distance
iv. Carpark ductless jet fan systems
For cost-effectiveness and flexibility, these non-compliances are usually submitted to SCDF as waiver applications with the relevant supporting reasons at the earliest stage. description:
STA Inspection Pte Ltd (STAI) was established in 1982 to provide vehicle inspection services in Singapore with approval from the Land Transport Authority (LTA). Since its inception, STAI has gone from an inspection company that is only restricted to the inspection of Heavy Goods Vehicles and motorcycles to one that is able to inspect all types of in-used vehicles in Singapore. STAI was also involved in the inspection of military vehilces since MINDEF started its requirement to have all its fleet of vehicles go through compulsory roadworthiness inspection and has since performed its duty with excellence till to-date. Today, we also handle the Vehicle Inspection and Type Approval System (VITAS) services for LTA in the areas of inspection and documentation e.g Type Approval, Change of Vehicle Particulars, etc.
With our quest to excel, we also provide consultancy vehicle inspection services in the set-up of inspection centres and training of inspectors as far back as in 1990s.
Currently we have 2 centres in Singapore using the state-of-the-art fully integrated test lane equipment with full connection between the two centres.
1n 1996, STAI was awarded the Approved Training Centre status by the Institute of Technical Education (ITE) for the conduct of the Motor Vehicle Inspection Course (MVIC) - an endorsement of the standards with which STAI conducts its overseas and local training. The inspectors in STAI are therefore fully trained on the MVIC with a minimum qualification of National Trade Certicate Level 3 (now, called NITEC)as required by LTA.
STAI becomes the first inspection company in Singapore to acheive the ISO 9002 certification in 1994. With its relentless pursuit for excellence, it achieved yet another first in the ISO 9001:2000 in 2000 and also becomes the first inspection company in Singapore to achieve the prestigious Singapore Quality Class accolade.

description: NLR is the Dutch knowledge enterprise for identifying, developing and applying advanced technological knowledge in the area of aerospace. NLR's mission is to increase the sustainability, safety and efficiency of air transport. In the safety domain, NLR develops and applies world-class knowledge and expertise to improve air transport safety. NLR supports stakeholders across the globe in air transport to understand and resolve complex safety implications of the new technologies and operations necessary to accommodate growth in air transport. Through its work for customers across the globe, and its participation in international committees and working groups, NLR  serves as an international knowledge centre on best practices in air transport safety. The main business areas of the institute are: 1) safety management (safety management system, safety culture, safety performance indicators and safety regulation); 2) Safety assessments (aeronautical study, safety case, obstacle assessment, FOSA); 3) flight procedure design; 4) safety modelling for advanced operations; 5) incident and accident investigation; and 6) safety training.

name: URBAN STRATEGIES INC.
description:
Urban Strategies Inc. is a full-service planning and urban design firm, based in Toronto, Canada.  Working for public and private sector clients, we shape and enhance urban places of all scales through strategic actions, holistic design and progressive policies.  Since 1981, our work has earned the firm dozens of awards and an international reputation.  Our hallmark:  consensus-driven solutions that are both visionary and achievable.
Philosophy:
Because every client, community and place are different, Urban Strategies� approaches each assignment with no preconceived formulas or solutions, but we do bring a philosophy of urbanism that includes the following tenets:
� The careful management of urban growth and controlled evolution of cities is essential to the quality of human lives and the health of the planet.
� City building is a great collective project that relies on many disciplines, citizen participation and an appreciation for history.
� Successful cities marry public and private interests, aligning them in the planning and design of communities.
� Streets are both the arteries and connective tissue of cities, the places for moving people and goods via transit, cars, trucks, bikes and feet, but also the places for enjoying the diverse cultures, tastes and merchandise a city offers.
� Development and open spaces should be located, shaped and designed in a way that enhances the character of neighbourhoods and the vitality of the public realm.
� Cities must be rooted in nature, and natural features and systems must be rooted in cities:  trees and green spaces should be plentiful, and water, whatever its shape or source, should be accessible and integrated into the design of places.
� Campuses are places and communities unto themselves, where efficiency, sustainable growth, a distinct identity and healthy connections to surroundings are critical to success.

description:
Viscoy Pte Ltd is a distributor of Remote Visual Inspection (RVI) equipment for Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and other applications in Singapore and the South East Asia region. The company carries a full range of RVI and Industrial Endoscopy equipment from Inspection Technologies Concepts GmBH, a German manufacturer of industrial endoscopes. Our products include videoscopes, fibrescopes, borescopes and related accessories (e.g. light sources, lenses, documentation units, etc). As a provider of RVI equipment solutions, our products can be customized to meet the specific requirements and/or tasks of the end user.
RVI equipment is used for the visual inspection of inaccessible areas (e.g. combustion chambers of engines, inside of pipes) with small access points (e.g. a drill hole). It has wide applications in the Aerospace/Aviation industry (inspection of turbines and engines), Oil and Gas industry (inspection of oil/gas pipes), Marine industry (inspection of engines and tanks), Automotive industry (inspection of engines), Manufacturing (quality assurance inspection of inaccessible parts of finished products) and Security.
For security applications, Viscoy Pte Ltd carries a range of RVI equipment developed specifically for law enforcement agencies and the military. These include customized videoscopes and fiberscopes for the inspection of potential hiding places for contrabands, such cavities in vehicles (e.g. fuel tanks, doors and ventilation systems in cars). Range of equipment also include observation kits for covert surveillance in tactical situations and environment (e.g. behind doors, round the corner, etc). These visual equipment are optimized for use in low to no light conditions.

name: ZEN TYRES PTE LTD
description:
Zen Tyres Pte Ltd was set up in 1999. Since then, the company has established a wide reputation as one of the leading provider for tyre service and retreading in Singapore.
PRODUCTS
We are equipped with a group of highly trained personnel and superior merchandise. This enabled us to help our customers lower their operating costs and cut down lead time by providing a range of quality products and services that include:
1.  New Tyres, Tubes and Flaps
2.  Retread Tyres
3.  Rims and Batteries
4.  24 / 7 Breakdown Services
ADDED VALUE SERVICES
1.  VEHICLE ALIGNMENT
As most of the unusual tyre wear is commonly caused by alignment issues, we have invested in a laser alignment equipment to identify and rectify the alignment problem more effectively.
2.  NITROGEN GAS INFLATING EQUIPMENT
Many race car teams and airline companies use nitrogen gas, instead of air in their tyres because nitrogen gas has more consistent rate of expansion and correction, compared to the usual  air.  With the customer's interest in mind, we had invested in a Nitrogen Inflating Equipment to provide nitrogen gas to the tyres.  This is suitable for long distance travelling vehicles with heavy loads.
TYRE TRAINING
In order to update customer's staff in tyre technology development, we are prepared to conduct tyre training programme annually, if required.
SERVICE REPORT
Summary of Service Report, on request, can be given monthly, so as to assist customers' on their update of the type of job being performed.
TYRE MANAGEMENT
The management concept started more than a decade ago, but it has not been fully utilised locally. Tyre Management system involves, the following:
1.  Quality tyre servicing
2.  Knowledge of appropriate use of tyre (e.g. tread pattern)
3.  Routine check on tyre (e.g. pressure and alignment)
4. Tyre rotation
5. Reuse of tyre casings for retreading
description_short: Supplies new and retread tyres, tubes, rims, batteries with 24/7 breakdown service, vehicle alignment, and nitrogen inflation for commercial and industrial vehicles.
